checkpeople.evidence: Homepage people form id heroTabPeople, POST to /landing, hidden _token and aid. firstName and lastName are marked required; city is a text box; state is a dropdown starting "All States". The catalog stored no form (robots.txt had disallowed the scan).
checkpeople.result_check: Submitting the form with a synthetic name through the browser-fetch service landed on a results page titled "Results For: John Smith" (information.com, the same operator's results host).

information-com.evidence: Homepage name form (firstName, lastName, city, state). Its script sends the search as a GET to /pf/<id>/searching, which forwards to /pf/nso1/res with the same parameters. The catalog stored no form (robots.txt had disallowed the scan).
information-com.result_check: GET /pf/nso1/res?firstName=John&lastName=Smith&city=&state= returned a results page titled "Results For: John Smith". The nso1 path segment is the site's own results path and may change.

peoplesearch-whitepages.evidence: Homepage form, GET to /search. s_name is required with placeholder "e.g. Jon Snow" (a whole name); s_loc is a combined city-and-state box and stays untagged. The stored form had s_name untagged. The rendered page had no CAPTCHA widget, so the stored reCAPTCHA marker is cleared.
peoplesearch-whitepages.result_check: GET /search?s_name=John+Smith returned "John Smith Phone Number & Address (100+ People Found)".

whitepages-411-com.evidence: Homepage form discovery-person-form has s_name (required, "e.g. John Smith") and s_loc, but a plain GET of its /search action returns 404: the page's script sends the name to /person-search/First-Last. url_pattern stores that path. The two controls are the path's parts, not page control names.
whitepages-411-com.result_check: The browser-fetch form submit of s_name=John Smith landed on /person-search/John-Smith, and a direct GET of that URL returned "John Smith | Phone Number & Address | 411". /person-search/John%20Smith returns 404, hence first and last name.

phonebooks-com.evidence: Homepage Name Search box (data-testid search-bar, no name attribute; the page builds the URL in script). Submitting it opens /employee-results?name=<name>. phonebooks-com.result_check: GET /employee-results?name=John+Smith returned "We Have 247 Results for John Smith" with ages and cities.

ufind-name.evidence: Homepage form, GET to /search, q is required with placeholder "Enter the name". The catalog stored no form (robots.txt had disallowed the scan). Country US: the result page lists US cities and states.
ufind-name.result_check: GET /search?q=John+Smith redirected to /John+Smith, titled "John Smith: 400 records - Addresses, Phone Numbers, Cars".

advancedbackgroundchecks.evidence: Homepage form with First Name and Last Name (both required), City (optional) and State (optional). The inputs have no name attribute; the page's script opens /find/name/first-last. The catalog stored the nameless controls, which Frame drops. The rendered page had no CAPTCHA widget, so the stored reCAPTCHA marker is cleared.
advancedbackgroundchecks.result_check: A browser submit of John / Smith opened /find/name/john-smith. GET of that URL through the browser-fetch service returned "John Smith - Public Records Search". A second read hit a Cloudflare challenge, so results are intermittent.

usa-people-search.evidence: Homepage form id PeopleForm, POST to /Results/Search, hidden _token and IsOptOut. Name has placeholder "Full Name"; Location ("City, State") stays untagged. The catalog stored no form (robots.txt had disallowed the scan). Country US from the site name and the US "City, State" location box.
usa-people-search.result_check: The browser-fetch form submit landed on /name/john-smith, which answered with a Cloudflare challenge the service did not clear. The form is right; the results page is walled.

searchpeoplefree.evidence: Homepage form (Alpine.js x-model first, middle, last, location; no name attributes). The script opens /find/first-last. The catalog stored the nameless controls, which Frame drops.
searchpeoplefree.result_check: A browser submit of John / Smith opened /find/john-smith behind a Cloudflare challenge; the browser-fetch service's read of /find/John-Smith failed with a 403. The form is right; the results page is walled.

names-and-facts.evidence: Homepage form id search-person-form, GET to /search. The search box has label "Search people" and placeholder "Name & Last Name". The catalog stored no form (robots.txt had disallowed the scan).
names-and-facts.result_check: GET /search?search=John+Smith answered with a Cloudflare challenge the browser-fetch service did not clear (twice). The form is right; the results page is walled.

whitepages.evidence: Homepage name form, GET to /header-search/name, s_name required ("e.g. John Snow") and s_loc ("e.g. Seattle, WA", untagged). The catalog had stored the phone box on the privacy-choices page as the search, so Frame asked for a phone number.
whitepages.result_check: GET /header-search/name?s_name=John+Smith redirected to /name/John-Smith?searchedName=John%20Smith, which answered with a Cloudflare challenge the browser-fetch service did not clear. The form is right; the results page is walled.

voterrecords-com.evidence: Homepage form id searchForm has one search box (name search, placeholder "John M Smith") with action "#". The page's Search() script strips non-letters, joins the words with hyphens, lowercases them, and opens /voters/<first>-<last>/1. url_pattern stores that path. The two controls are the path's parts, not page control names. The catalog stored no form (robots.txt had disallowed the scan). Country US: the site says it holds more than 100 million US voter records.
voterrecords-com.result_check: GET /voters/John-Smith/1 (and /voters/john-smith/1) returned "John Smith has 5,111 Voter Records".
